results.name: Dumbbell Overhead Extension Standing
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands. Hold a dumbbell with your fingers wrapped around the dumbbell handle.
Slowly bend your elbows, lowering the dumbbell behind your head until your forearms are parallel to the floor.
Press the dumbbell back up by straightening your elbows, returning to the starting position with arms fully extended overhead.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your head throughout the movement to maximize triceps activation.
Use a controlled motion, avoiding any jerking or swinging of the weight.
Maintain a firm grip on the dumbbell to ensure stability and control.
results.description: Dumbbell Overhead Extension Standing is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Pronate-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet firmly planted on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Extend your arms bent behind your head, keeping your arms at 45 degrees, holding the dumbbell with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Keeping your elbows stationary, bend your arms to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your elbows to raise the dumbbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on moving only your forearms; your upper arms should remain stationary.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement.
Use a controlled motion and avoid swinging the weight.
results.description: Dumbbell Pronate-Grip Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Bench Extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell with both hands, positioning it behind your head.
Begin with your elbows bent and pointed upwards, keeping your upper arms close to your head.
Extend your elbows to lift the dumbbell upwards until your arms are fully extended, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, bending your elbows.
tips: Avoid flaring your elbows out; keep them close to your head.
Exhale as you extend your elbows and inhale as you lower the dumbbell.
Ensure a slow and controlled movement to maintain proper form.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Bench Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Kickback
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, leaning slightly forward from your hips while keeping your back straight.
Lift both upper arms so that they are parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle. Your forearms should be hanging down, and your palms facing your body.
Extend your arms straight back by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arm stationary. Squeeze your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly bend your elbows to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Exhale as you extend your arm and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Use a controlled motion, focusing on squeezing your triceps at the top.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Kickback is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly planted and hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest using a neutral grip.
Keep your upper arms fixed, then bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Extend your elbows to raise the dumbbells along the same path until your arms are straight.
Repeat for the required amount of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing upward instead of allowing them to flare outward.
Maintain contact between your head, upper back, hips, and the bench.
Hold your upper arms steady and move only through your elbows.
Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you extend your elbows.
results.description: Dumbbell Skullcrusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Chest.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Both Arms Kickback
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your torso almost parallel to the floor.
Begin with your arms bent at 90 degrees, elbows close to your sides, and dumbbells hanging down.
Extend both arms straight back by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary and close to your body. Focus on squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly bend your elbows to return the dumbbells to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back flat and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Keep your head in a neutral position, looking slightly forward.
Exhale as you extend your arms back and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Both Arms Kickback is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand and place your left hand to your hip for support. Raise your right arm overhead, extending it fully with your palm facing forward.
Keep your upper arm stationary and your elbow close to your head. Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow.
Extend your arm back to the starting position by straightening your elbow. Ensure your upper arm remains stationary throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left arm.
tips: Focus on isolating the triceps, minimizing movement in your shoulder and upper arm.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbow to avoid locking out the joint.
Breathe out as you extend the dumbbell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands behind your head. Your elbows should be bent, and your upper arms should be close to your ears.
Extend your arms fully by pressing the dumbbell overhead until your arms are straight. Keep your elbows close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell back down behind your head by bending your elbows, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the extension and flexion of your arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid flaring your elbows out; keep them close to your ears.
Use a controlled motion, avoiding swinging the dumbbell.
Exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you lower the dumbbell.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Position the dumbbells above your chest, with your arms fully extended and your palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells inward and towards your chest, keeping the dumbbells facing forward.
Bring the dumbbells together just before touching your chest, elbows pointing out to the sides.
Extend your arms back to the starting position, extending the dumbbells upward. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
Focus on controlled movements and avoid using momentum.
Choose a weight that allows for proper form and full range of motion.
results.description: Dumbbell Tate Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kick Back Single Arm
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at your hips, keeping your back straight. Place your left hand on your left knee for support.
Lift your right elbow backward to bring the dumbbell close to your torso, with your upper arm parallel to the floor and your forearm perpendicular to the floor.
Extend your right arm fully behind you by straightening your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary. Squeeze your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly return the dumbbell to the starting position by bending your elbow. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left arm and repeat.
tips: Keep your upper arm close to your body and stationary throughout the exercise.
Focus on a slow and controlled movement to maximize triceps engagement.
Avoid swinging the weight; use only your triceps to perform the movement.
results.description: Dumbbell Triceps Kick Back Single Arm is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.
